dev setup process
Install Visual Studio 2022 Preview  (tested preview 7.0)
Add env variables to windows
	myPC right button / menu properties
		advanced system setting
			Environement variables
				set AAAOut to where it should compile : C:\AAAOut for me
				set AAAGaBuZo to the running dir : M:\AAA\AAAGaBuZo for me
Open the solution with VS : all the newdesign v143 x64 version should be able to compile and link
	Debug as the name say Debug (edit and continue)
	Release have the symbols but faster code
	MetalTuned the ultimate optimisation but no Debug
	WoodTuned as MetalTuned but non Avx 2 so it can run on older/cheaper machines (e.g. the one just for Kinect)
At this point you should be abble on compile AAASeed but running it from VS would trigger dialog about missing dll.
	Usually I set a diretory with all the dll and then add it the system path (in my case M:\AAA\AAAGaBuZo_Dll\Main_x64 )
		using the same dialog  Environement variables mentionned previously
